newsitem.title: UK: Fortune plans cash call, details JV.
newsitem.headline: Fortune plans cash call, details JV.

text.p: Fortune Oil Plc said on Friday that it plans a 3-for-14 rights issue at 11p per share to raise 23.4 million stg, partly to help finance its investment in a joint venture.
The company plans an initial investment of 12.1 million stg in a joint venture to provide aviation fuel and aircraft refuelling services in central and southern China.

Fortune announced in January that it was taking a 24.5 percent stake in a joint venture with China Aviation Oil Supply Corporation and Vitol Holding B.V. The joint venture is called South China Bluesky Aviation Oil Company Ltd.
Fortune will also use proceeds from the rights issue to finance the expansion of the chain of Fortune Oil petrol stations in China and to reduce debt.
The rights issue is being underwritten by Hoare Govett.
